did.description: The account whose queue holds the message. Omitted = the requester's own account. A requester without administrative standing may name only itself.

Response.title: Messaging — Get Message — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/message/get request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/message/get/0.1#response.

message.description: The stored message exactly as the mediator holds it — a DIDComm JWE/JWS as JSON text, a TSP message as CESR qb64 text. The mediator does not decrypt it. Bounded at 10 MiB; a stored message larger than that is refused with messageTooLarge rather than truncated.
